boards.product: ESP32-S3 AIoT Basic V2 development board
boards.hardware: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM; 1.3-inch 240x240 IPS LCD (ST7789); onboard camera (this firmware drives a GC2145); digital mic, amplifier, buzzer, light sensor, WS2812 RGB LED; Grove connector
boards.identify: Large learning board, about 145 x 135 mm, with nine onboard modules: buttons, buzzer, LED, light sensor, LCD, mic, SD slot, amplifier, camera
boards.flash_port: USB-C. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Camera preview on the LCD; a button (or the App) takes a snapshot that goes to the App over BLE

zh.product: ESP32-S3 AIoT Basic V2 开发板
zh.hardware: ESP32-S3，16 MB Flash，8 MB PSRAM；1.3 寸 240x240 IPS 屏（ST7789）；板载摄像头（本固件驱动 GC2145）；数字麦克风、功放、蜂鸣器、光敏传感器、WS2812 彩灯；Grove 接口
zh.identify: 较大的学习板，约 145 x 135 mm，板上有九个模块：按键、蜂鸣器、LED、光敏、屏幕、麦克风、SD 卡座、功放、摄像头
zh.flash_port: USB-C。下载模式：按住 BOOT 再插 USB。
zh.use: 摄像头画面显示在屏幕上；按键（或 App）拍照，照片通过 BLE 发给 App
